subject: Re: NoCode Bootcamp — partner credit allocation and usage guardrails
messages:
From: Ava Patel <ava@nocode-labs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NoCode Bootcamp — request for partner credits

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the intro at the Summit last month — excited about the potential fit between Redwood and the NoCode Bootcamp. We're running a multi-week cohort for 400 students in July and would love to feature Redwood in the curriculum and the marketplace.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider sponsoring promotional credits for attendees (we typically request a voucher pool we can distribute)? For planning purposes, we're thinking about a $3k–$5k credit pool to cover demo work and early integrations. We can commit to co-marketing the cohort (one webinar + blog) and provide attribution via marketplace metadata.

I've attached a short cohort sponsorship pack and expected attendee usage. Happy to jump on a call if useful.

Best,
Ava Patel
Head of Partnerships — NoCode Labs

Attachment: nocode_bootcamp_proposal.pdf (1 page)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NoCode Bootcamp — request for partner credits

Looping you both in — NoCode Labs is asking for a voucher pool to support a 400-person bootcamp in July. They propose $3k–$5k in Redwood credits, exchange for one webinar and a blog. Attached is their one-pager.

I think this is a good top-of-funnel play and a lightweight partner activation. Suggested approach: approve a conditional voucher of $3k, 90-day expiry, and require marketplace attribution + a short usage report at 45 days. Ben — can CS run the milestone check? Kimberly — can ops confirm we can issue a marketplace voucher with the attribution fields NoCode needs?

If we can get it aligned, I can send a formal offer to Ava and request a brief co-marketing timeline.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Ecosystem Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: nocode_bootcamp_proposal.pdf (forwarded)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: NoCode Bootcamp — request for partner credits

Thanks Hannah — quick operational notes:

- Marketplace vouchers: we can create a voucher code that ties back to NoCode Labs as the source. Works fine.
- Expiry: 90 days is standard; we can auto-expire unused balance.
- Attribution: we need them to pass the marketplace referral tag (utm_partner_id) or the voucher redemption metadata; we can include a field for cohort_id.
- Compliance: if they want invoicing or a contractual commitment, we should route to legal; for a simple promotional voucher no contract required.

I've attached our standard credit_terms_template.docx — please review the suggested guardrails (max per-account redemption, telemetry enabled for usage).

If we're doing co-marketing, let's request a simple one-page case-study and the webinar date to lock promo timing.

Attachment: credit_terms_template.docx

—Kimberly
Head, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NoCode Bootcamp — request for partner credits

I like the runway but want to tighten success criteria so the credits drive meaningful product engagement:

Proposal: approve $3,000 in promotional credits (total pool) with the following conditions:
- 90-day expiry from issue date
- Maximum redemption $250 per unique account to encourage many students to try it
- Require a simple usage milestone report at day 45 (number of unique redemptions, avg tokens consumed)
- If redemption < 20 accounts by day 45, credits are revokable (or we can top up if co-marketing milestones are hit)

Marissa — CS can own the 45-day report and a webinar enablement doc?

Ben
Senior Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

To: Ava Patel <ava@nocode-labs.com>, Jesse Miller <jesse.miller@nocode-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NoCode Bootcamp — request for partner credits

Hi Ava and Jesse —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the proposal. We're happy to support the NoCode Bootcamp with a promotional voucher pool. Final terms:

- Voucher amount: $3,000 total Redwood credits
- Expiry: 90 days from voucher issuance
- Max redemption: $250 per unique account
- Attribution: redeeming users must include the cohort voucher code; please pass cohort_id in the marketplace metadata so we can track redemptions
- Reporting: NoCode Labs will provide a usage summary at day 45 (unique redemptions, basic token usage), and Redwood will produce an engagement summary at day 90

Conditions: Redwood credits are promotional and non-refundable; if by day 45 fewer than 20 unique accounts have redeemed, we reserve the right to pause or revoke remaining credit balance unless mutual co-marketing milestones (webinar + one blog) are completed.

Next steps: Kimberly will create the voucher and send the code. Marissa will coordinate the CS enablement doc for your instructors. Once voucher code is ready, please share the webinar date and the co-marketing copy so we can finalize the announcement.

Looking forward to the cohort — we appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Ecosystem Partnerships
Redwood Inference
